data_objects.name: county_vote_results
data_objects.meaning: County-level election vote totals, party shares, margins, and geographic identifiers.

variables.name: votes_dem
variables.meaning: Number of votes reported for the Democratic candidate or party.

variables.name: votes_gop
variables.meaning: Number of votes reported for the Republican or GOP candidate or party.

variables.name: total_votes
variables.meaning: Total votes reported for the county record.

variables.name: per_dem
variables.meaning: Democratic share of the reported total vote, stored as a decimal fraction.

variables.name: per_gop
variables.meaning: Republican or GOP share of the reported total vote, stored as a decimal fraction.

variables.name: diff
variables.meaning: Reported vote-count difference, stored as text with a thousands separator.

variables.name: per_point_diff
variables.meaning: Reported party-share difference, stored as percent-formatted text.

variables.name: state_abbr
variables.meaning: State abbreviation associated with the county record.

structure.description: Each row is a county or county-equivalent election result identified by state_abbr, county_name, and combined_fips; shares are numeric fractions while margin fields use formatted text.

uncertainties: The election year, office, candidates, and treatment of votes outside the two named party columns are not stated.
The table does not explicitly say whether diff and per_point_diff are signed or absolute margins, and leading-zero preservation for combined_fips is not documented.
annotation_notes: Party and geography meanings follow explicit source labels; election context not present in train.csv is left unresolved.
